'''R3-D3''' was an [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series astromech droid]] working for [[Star Tours]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> R3-D3 was in the [[Droidnostics Center]] of the [[Tomorrowland Starport]] with other damaged [[Droid/Legends|droids]] waiting to be repaired around the time of the [[Battle of Death Star III]]. It had a bad [[Motivator/Legends|motivator]].<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This droid can be seen inside the queue of [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']].<ref name="ST" /> [[Hasbro]] released R3-D3 as an exclusive [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] action figure.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|pack=R3-D3|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjr3d3.asp}}</ref> A photo taken of the droid shows a tag attached to it, labeling it "due for maintenance" and "bad motivator."

While some fan sources identified the droid right next to R3-D3 as [[R3-A2/Legends|R3-A2]]<ref name="EE">{{EndorExpress|url=database/r3-a2|text=R3-A2}}</ref>, no official source has done so.
